_meta.role: Robotics Research Intern, Robot Learning (Fall 2026) | PhD Part-time Internship

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built a LeRobot-structured multi-camera data collection pipeline and a flow-matching-inspired policy stack for a physical voice-controlled robotic arm, validating perception, planning, and control end to end on real hardware (UR5e, Jetson, Arduino) with 100% pick reliability across 10 trials. Research background spans distributed training on SLURM-managed clusters, ROS2-based robotic arm kinematics and planning, and from-scratch foundation model implementation (GPT-2-style Transformer), with experience leading a cross-institutional research team from experiment design through evaluation.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with augmentation and batch-loading for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student; took over as team lead mid-project to restructure task distribution and deliver the full research pipeline within the 6-week window.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a LeRobot-structured data collection pipeline using multiprocessing for multi-camera frame capture on a physical robot platform (Jetson + Arduino).
Integrated faster-whisper STT, Gemini intent classification, and TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup) for visual servoing with dual ToF-sensor contact-aware grasping.
Resolved 11 integration failures across the real-robot pipeline; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Implemented distributed dendrite computations across MPI workers with synchronous soma updates on a SLURM-managed cluster.
Achieved up to 10.49x speedup with 12 slave processes; characterized scaling behavior across dendrite counts and compartment depths.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
